consensus.title: Shared Indicator
consensus.help: When enabled, the team or co-op group shares a single indicator that everyone moves together — wherever it ends up is the answer. When disabled, each player has their own indicator, and the team's answer is the average of everyone's final position.

winAmountRounds.title: Rounds
winAmountRounds.help: How many rounds the match lasts. Auto scales the round count based on how many players are in the match: 4 rounds for 2 players, 3 for 3-4, 2 for 5-6, and 1 for 7 or more.

revealTime.title: Result Display Time
revealTime.help: How long the results are shown after each clue is revealed.

promptSelection.title: Prompt Selection
promptSelection.help: When enabled, players choose from 3 different spectrums each round instead of being assigned one.

stepScoring.title: Step Scoring
stepScoring.help: When enabled, points are awarded in fixed bands (75/50/25) based on distance from the target instead of scaling smoothly.

authorPoints.title: Clue Giver Bonus
authorPoints.help: When enabled, the clue giver earns half of the average points guessers score from their clue, rounded down. Solo mode only.

visibility.title: Live Positions
visibility.help: Controls who can see where others are moving on the spectrum in real-time.

description.ALL: All players see each other's live position on the spectrum.
description.TEAM: Players only see their teammates' live positions.
description.PRIVATE: No one can see where others are on the spectrum.

default.title: Versus
description: Points based on how close your guess is

teams.title: Teams
description: Guess is the average of your team

coopConsensus.title: Classic Co-op
description: Move a single shared indicator together
Points are scored in fixed bands

coopDemocracy.title: Democracy Co-op
description: Guess is the average of your team

rules.title: How to Play
description: Each round, every player gets a secret target on a spectrum (e.g. Hot ← → Cold) and writes a clue hinting at it, without using the scale's own words.
All players then get to guess where the clue lands for each other's clues. The closer the guess, the more points you score.

modes.title: Game Modes
description: Solo: Everyone guesses on their own and scores individually.
Co-op: The whole group shares one score together.
Team: Pick a team color in the lobby; each team scores separately.

customize.title: Customize the Rules
description: Tweak scoring, indicators, and more in the lobby settings. Settings such as switching to step-based scoring instead of distance-based.

multipleLanguages.title: Multiple languages detected
multipleLanguages.description: We noticed players using different languages. To ensure everyone understands the clues, select all the languages you understand — once everyone has at least one in common, the game will start.
multipleLanguages.leave: I can't participate in any of these languages
multipleLanguages.leaveDescription: That's completely fine — no statistics or wins will be recorded for anyone if you leave now.
multipleLanguages.agreedDescription: Everyone agrees to use {language} for their clues!

cluePicking.title: Write your clue
cluePicking.description: Keep your clue vague but accurate — others will use it to guess your position.

info.stayQuietHint: Don't give any extra hints while others are guessing!
info.tunedInWinThreshold: Score at least {threshold} points together to win!
